spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §6.2 (402 INVALID_STATE: request illegal for the current state)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.4 invariant 1 (every request answered exactly once)
description: State violation: AuthInit sent in READY (a fully set-up session) — illegal for the current state, answered with fatal Error(402)+Close(402).
preconditions: Session READY: authenticated, negotiated, configuration published; a stream may be running.

The READY rows of spec §5.2 enumerate Subscribe/Unsubscribe/RequestConfiguration/Close; an AuthInit there is a request illegal for the current state, i.e. 402 by the registry's definition; invariant 1 (every request answered) forbids a silent ignore.
Isolated connection; the Client's request_id counter has reached 9 in this replay.
assertions: The Error echoes request_id 9 (the frame decoded to a known message).
Fatal pairing: Error+Close with the same code, then the transport close (spec §5.2).
Re-authentication of a live session is never in-place; a new session supersedes the old via code 303 instead (spec §5.2).
